meta.title: React Library catalog
meta.description: Canonical, hand-maintained component catalog. schema v2 adds optional multi-source, aesthetic, preview and provenance fields (docs/SCHEMA.md §v2); absent fields default to a legacy 'local' entry. catalog/index.json is derived - run 'npm run generate' after editing this file; never hand-edit the index.

entries.name: Alert
entries.summary: Calls out a user-facing message as a tone-aware severity banner.
entries.description: Use an Alert to deliver a short, important message that belongs in the page flow: confirmations, warnings, or errors. The tone slot maps to theme-aware colors and a severity icon.

props.name: tone
props.description: Severity class that drives color and icon.

props.name: title
props.description: Short headline rendered before the body.

props.name: dismissible
props.description: Renders a dismiss button; dismissal is uncontrolled.

entries.a11yNotes: Renders with role="alert" so content is announced when inserted.

entries.name: Badge
entries.summary: Compact rounded label for statuses, counts and metadata.
entries.description: A Badge is a short, non-interactive label attached to other content: release channels, counts, or states. Tone variants map to theme-aware colors rather than fixed hexes.

entries.name: Button
entries.summary: Accessible action button with visual variants and sizes.
entries.description: The primary actionable control of the library. Buttons render as a real <button>, expose variant and size slots, and inherit focus styling from the active theme (--rl-focus).
entries.a11yNotes: Native button semantics; focus ring from theme token --rl-focus.

entries.name: Card
entries.summary: Themed surface container that groups related content.
entries.description: Card is the base surface for grouping content. Elevation, padding, and optional header title all resolve through theme tokens, so the same Card looks native in every theme.

props.name: elevation
props.description: Whether the card lifts from the surface.

entries.name: Blur Fade (Magic UI)
entries.summary: Blur Fade: Magic UI animated component, vendored with manifest; integrates via Tailwind in the target project.
entries.description: Blur Fade is vendored from the official Magic UI registry (MIT). The component pairs with shadcn/ui and uses Tailwind classes plus the cn() helper; see the recorded dependencies. The React Library app previews it via the official docs since Tailwind is not part of this app's runtime.

entries.name: Ballpit (React Bits)
entries.summary: Physics ball-pit background from React Bits; reference entry with official registry retrieval.
entries.description: Reference to React Bits' Ballpit animated background (official category: Backgrounds). The MIT + Commons Clause license permits using the component in applications but forbids redistributing the components themselves, so this catalog keeps metadata and official retrieval only.
entries.retrieval: npx shadcn@latest add @react-bits/Ballpit-TS-TW (official registry https://reactbits.dev/r/{name}.json; MCP also supported - https://reactbits.dev/get-started/mcp). Check the returned files' imports for actual dependencies before installing.

license.note: MIT + Commons Clause v1.0: sale/sublicense/redistribution of the components themselves is forbidden; use inside an application is permitted.

entries.name: TabSheet
entries.summary: Switchable panel set following the WAI-ARIA tabs pattern.
entries.description: TabSheet renders a labeled set of panels with an accessible tablist. Selection follows focus with a roving tabindex, and the tablist supports ArrowLeft/ArrowRight plus Home/End navigation.

props.name: items
props.type: Array<{ id: string; label: string; content: React.ReactNode }>

props.name: initialTab
props.description: Id of the tab selected on mount.

entries.a11yNotes: role=tablist/tab/tabpanel wiring; arrow-key navigation with roving tabindex and selection-follows-focus.

entries.name: TextInput
entries.summary: Labeled single-line text field with validation state.
entries.description: TextInput pairs a visible label with a real <input>, supports helper text and an invalid state, and inherits theme colors and radius from the active theme.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label bound to the control.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Controlled change handler receiving the next string value.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the field as failing validation.

props.name: helperText
props.description: Hint rendered under the field; doubles as the error message when invalid.

entries.a11yNotes: Label is programmatically bound; helper text links via aria-describedby; invalid sets aria-invalid.
